sentences.text: Learned APP Ms. Jhaveri waives service of Rule on behalf of the respondent-State.

2. By way of this application the applicant convict prays for being released on parole leave for the purpose of filing appeal against the order of conviction.
3.

Jail remarks would show that the applicant has been convicted for offence punishable under Section 376(3) of the Indian Penal Code and under the provisions of POCSO Act and sentenced to undergo 20 years imprisonment and whereas the applicant appears to have undergone approximately 02 years imprisonment as of now.
It also appears that the applicant has never been released on any kind of leave whatsoever.
4. Considering the said aspects and considering the reasons stated in the present application, the present application deserves consideration.

The applicant is directed to be released on parole leave for a period of 15 Days (Fifteen Days) from the date of his actual release on executing personal R/SCR.A/3672/2023 ORDER DATED: 21/03/2023 bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand)
